content.comment_body: Hi everyone, After checking some examples on [company_name]'s website, I am encountering an error message. Could someone assist me with this? I recently downloaded [product_name] and updated it via the update center. Program version: [version_no] Program timestamp: 2008-07-04 15-00 Language: en_US Language version: [version_no] Updates: Upgrade [version_no] (Windows) ([article_no]: addon, setup_win_[version_no].luf) English [version_no] ([article_no]: language, english_[version_no].luf) Update [version_no] ([article_no]: servicepack, Update_[version_no].luf) Upgrade [version_no] (Windows) ([article_no]: addon, setup_w Thanks in advance for your help. Regards, [user_name]
You did not specify which error message you received. Best regards,
I have attached the error message for reference. Please review the attachment and let me know your thoughts. Regards, [user_name]
It's not possible to open files directly from a temporary directory. Please download the files, extract them to a folder of your choice, and then open them from there. Best regards,

Done, thank you. Interestingly, some files are opening while others still do not. I will try downloading all files again to see if that resolves the issue. Meanwhile, could you advise on creating an On-delay timer for 7 days? The maximum duration currently seems to be 99 hours. Regards, [user_name]
For extended durations like 7 days, you can use the operating hours counter as a workaround. Best regards,

analysis.insight_summary: The user had trouble accessing example files after updating [product_name] to [version_no] on Windows, primarily due to error messages while trying to open files from a temporary folder. The issue was resolved by extracting the files to a local directory. However, the user then encountered a limitation within the software, which only supports On-delay timers up to 99 hours and does not allow direct configuration for a 7-day timer.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects smooth access to example files without errors and wants to be able to set On-delay timers for durations up to 7 days in [product_name].
